title: Investigating African-American Vernacular English in Transformer-Based Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting GPT-2 with intent-equivalent segments of African American Vernacular English (AAVE) and Standard American English (SAE) tweet pairs, then comparing the generated text using sentiment analysis classifiers (DistilBERT, VADER, TextBlob), text quality metrics (BLEU, ROUGE), and human evaluation.
